entries.jp: いや～　今日の雷舞も\n最高じゃったぜよー
entries.en: Whew! Today's\nlive was the best\nyet, I tell ya!

entries.jp: ……ふん\nまあまあだ
entries.en: ...Hmph. It\nwas passable.

entries.jp: そんなこと言って～\nお客さんのノリも\n良かったじゃないですか
entries.en:
Oh, you say that,
but the audience
was really into
it, weren't they?

entries.jp: っつか　龍馬　テメェ！\nまーた二曲目の\n入りでトチったな！
entries.en:
And YOU,
Ryoma! You
botched the intro
to the second
song again!

entries.jp: げっ　バレてたのか
entries.en: Yikes, ya noticed?

entries.jp: あれくらいなら\nカバーするのは造作もない\n気にするな
entries.en:
A slip like that
is easy to
cover. Don't
worry about it.

entries.jp: ヒジゾーさん！\n優しいぜよ～～っ\nくぅ　泣けるぅ
entries.en: Hijizo-san! You're\nso kind! Sniff...\nI'm gonna cry!

entries.jp: 下手が無理しても\nミスが増えるだけだ\nからな
entries.en:
Pushing it when
you're no good
just means
more mistakes.

entries.jp: ううっ　ヒジゾーさんは\nシンディと違って\n淡々ときっついぜよ……
entries.en:
Ugh... Hijizo-san
ain't like Shindy.
He says the
harshest stuff
all calm-like...

entries.jp: いやいや　土方さんも\nスカシくんと一緒で\n素直じゃないだけだよ？
entries.en:
Nah, nah.
Hijikata-san is
just like Mr.
Poser. He's just
not honest about
his feelings, you
know?

entries.jp: おい　総司
entries.en: Hey, Soji.

entries.jp:
つまり　何かあっても俺が
手助け（フォロー）するから
気にせず歌え
ってことですよね
entries.en:
In other words:
"Whatever
happens, I'll cover
for you, so don't
worry and just
sing." That's what
he means, right?

entries.jp: ……桂まで
entries.en: ...Katsura,\nyou too?

entries.jp: ですよね～\n土方さん～
entries.en: Riiight,\nHijikata-san~?

entries.jp: ……余計なことを\n言うな　総司
entries.en: ...Don't say\nunnecessary\nthings, Soji.

entries.jp: 誤解されやすい土方さんの\n言い訳（フォロー）してる\nだけです～
entries.en:
I'm just covering
for Hijikata-san,
since people
misunderstand
him so easily~

entries.jp: ソウちん\nあんがとな
entries.en: So-chin,\nthanks, pal.

entries.jp: いえいえ～♪\nでも　土方さんは僕の\nだからね　トサカくん
entries.en:
Don't mention it~
But Hijikata-san
is mine, got it,
Tosaka-kun?

entries.jp: お　おお
entries.en: R-right.

entries.jp: それにしても……\n本当に自由に歌を歌える\nようになったんですねぇ
entries.en: Still... we really\ncan sing freely\nnow, can't we?

entries.jp: 井伊を倒し　幕府の\n怨霊とやらを倒した\nおかげだぜ！
entries.en:
All thanks to
beating Ii and
those shogunate
ghosts or
whatever!

entries.jp: 上様……いやもう違うのか\n慶喜様も思い切った\n決断をなさったよね
entries.en:
His Highness...
no, not anymore,
I suppose.
Yoshinobu-sama
sure made a
bold decision,
didn't he?

entries.jp: ああ　まさか幕府を解体し\n新しい政府に全てを任せて\nしまわれるとは……
entries.en:
Yes. Who would
have thought he'd
dismantle the
shogunate and
leave everything
to a new
government...

entries.jp: でもさ～\n慶喜様はずっと幸せに\nなったんじゃないかな
entries.en:
But hey~ I bet
Yoshinobu-sama
is way
happier now.

entries.jp: だな　二条城の\nあの部屋から出て\n解放されたろう
entries.en:
Yeah. He's out
of that room
in Nijo Castle.
He's free now.

entries.jp: お気の毒でしたものね\nあれは監禁されていた\nのと変わりない……
entries.en:
The poor man.
That was no
different
from being
imprisoned...

entries.jp: 隠居用の屋敷は\nささやかだが
entries.en: His retirement\nresidence is\nmodest, but...

entries.jp: 気に入っておられる\nようだし\n良かったのだろうな
entries.en: ...he seems to like\nit. I suppose it\nwas for the best.

entries.jp: わしはまた慶喜様の\nところに歌いに行くぜよ
entries.en:
I'm gonna
go sing for
Yoshinobu-sama
again!

entries.jp: へえ\n僕も行こうかな？
entries.en: Huh. Maybe\nI'll come too?

entries.jp: うんうん　ソウちんも\n一緒に行くぜよ\nそれに今度
entries.en: Yeah, yeah, come\nalong, So-chin!\nAnd next time...

entries.jp: わしらの雷舞を聴きに来る\n言うとったぜよ
entries.en: ...he said he'd\ncome hear\nour live!

entries.jp: ええっ？
entries.en: Whaaat?

entries.jp: おっ　おい！\nいつの間にそんな話に！
entries.en: H-hey! When did\nTHAT happen!?

entries.jp: なにせわしら\n魂友だからなっ！
entries.en: Well, we're\nsoulmates,\nafter all!

entries.jp: 雷舞の話も\nいっぱいしたんじゃ\nそしたら
entries.en:
We talked a
whole lot about
our live shows,
too. And then...

entries.jp: まだ　外に出るのは\n怖いけど　雷舞のために\n頑張ると言うとったぜよ
entries.en:
...he said goin'
outside still
scares him, but
he'd do his best
for the live!

entries.jp: なんと畏れおおい……\n我々の雷舞に上様……\nいや　慶喜様が
entries.en:
How very
humbling... His
Highness... no,
Yoshinobu-sama,
at our live...

entries.jp: 慶喜様と魂友って　\nトサカくん　すごいなー
entries.en:
Soulmates with
Yoshinobu-sama?
Tosaka-kun,
that's amazing.

entries.jp: しかし　慶喜様が\nいらっしゃるならば
entries.en: Still, if\nYoshinobu-sama\nis coming...

entries.jp: 次の雷舞　いつも以上に\n気合いを入れねばな
entries.en:
...we'll have to
put more fire
than usual into
the next live.

entries.jp: そんなもんかのう\nいつもどおりでええと\n思うんじゃが
entries.en:
Ya think so?
I reckon we
can just do it
like always.

entries.jp: 慶喜様に対して\nそんなわけにいくか
entries.en: In front of\nYoshinobu-sama?\nWe can't do that.

entries.jp: トサカくんは\n度胸ありすぎだよ～
entries.en: Tosaka-kun,\nyou've got way\ntoo much nerve~

entries.jp:
そんなたわいもない
やりとりをしながら
京の町を歩く龍馬たち
しかし　そんな龍馬たちを
見つめる黒い影があった
entries.en:
Chatting idly
like this, Ryoma
and the others
walked through
the streets of
Kyoto. But a
dark shadow was
watching them.

entries.jp: まあ　でも\n慶喜様が好きな歌は\n入れようと思うんじゃ
entries.en:
Well, still, I'm
thinkin' we
oughta put in
the songs
Yoshinobu-sama
likes.

entries.jp: そう言って龍馬が角を\n曲がろうとした瞬間
entries.en:
Just as Ryoma
said that and
started to turn
the corner...

entries.jp: ぐっっ！
entries.en: Ngh!!

entries.jp: 突然の銃声に\nみんなの足が止まる
entries.en: A sudden gunshot\nstopped everyone\nin their tracks.

entries.jp: そしてさっきまで\n笑顔で話していた龍馬が\nゆっくりと倒れていく
entries.en:
And Ryoma,
who had been
chatting with a
smile a moment
ago, slowly fell.

entries.jp: \fnt1龍馬！\fnt0
entries.en: \fnt1Ryoma!\fnt0

entries.jp: \fnt1龍馬くんっ！\fnt0
entries.en: \fnt1Ryoma-kun!\fnt0

entries.jp: 高杉と桂が\n龍馬に駆け寄り\n土方が銃声の方を向く
entries.en:
Takasugi and
Katsura rushed
to Ryoma, and
Hijikata turned
toward the
gunshot.

entries.jp: \fnt1誰だっ\fnt0
entries.en: \fnt1Who's there!?\fnt0

entries.jp: くくくっ……やったぞ！\n徳川幕府の\n恨み　思い知れ！
entries.en:
Heh heh heh...
I did it! Feel
the grudge of
the Tokugawa
shogunate!

entries.jp: 坂本　龍馬
entries.en: Ryoma Sakamoto.

entries.jp: \fnt1待てっっ！\fnt0
entries.en: \fnt1Stop!!\fnt0

entries.jp: 無理だよ　土方さん\nあいつ　忍だ\n相当逃げ足が速い……
entries.en:
No use,
Hijikata-san. That
guy's a ninja. He's
way too fast on
his feet...

entries.jp: くっ
entries.en: Tch.

entries.jp: それより龍馬くんが\n弾に当たって……っ
entries.en: More importantly,\nRyoma-kun's been\nhit...!

entries.jp: こいつ　胸を\n撃たれてる……\n息をしてねえんだ！
entries.en: He's been shot in\nthe chest... He's\nnot breathing!

entries.jp: まさか\n心臓を撃たれたのか
entries.en: Don't tell me...\nhe was shot\nin the heart?

entries.jp: トサカくん
entries.en: Tosaka-kun...

entries.jp: 胸を押さえて\n地面に倒れた龍馬に\nみんなが駆け寄る
entries.en:
Everyone rushed
to Ryoma, who
had fallen to the
ground clutching
his chest.

entries.jp: おい！　目ぇ開けろよ！\nおい！　嘘だろ……
entries.en:
Hey! Open
your eyes! Hey!
You've gotta be
kidding me...

entries.jp: 坂本……\nそんなバカな
entries.en: Sakamoto...\nThis can't be...

entries.jp:
土方も
目を閉じ動かない
龍馬を見て愕然と
膝をつく
entries.en:
Hijikata too sank
to his knees,
stunned, at the
sight of Ryoma
lying still with
his eyes closed.

entries.jp: なぜだ……！\nお前はあの呪いの歌にも\n怨霊にも打ち勝った
entries.en:
Why...! You
overcame that
cursed song, and
the vengeful
spirits too...

entries.jp: なのに　こんなところで\nあっけなく死ぬのか
entries.en: And yet you die\nso easily, in a\nplace like this?

entries.jp: そんなのオレ様が許すか！\nいいから目を開けろ！
entries.en:
Like the great
Takasugi
would ever
allow that! Just
open your eyes!

entries.jp: オレ様はまだテメェに\n言ってねぇことが\n山ほどあるんだよ！
entries.en:
The great
Takasugi still
has a mountain
of things he
never told you!

entries.jp: 俺もだ\nこんなことならもっと\n本音で話せば良かった
entries.en:
So do I. If I'd
known, I would
have spoken
my mind more.

entries.jp: ああ　口を開けば\n喧嘩ばっかり売って……
entries.en:
Yeah... Every
time I opened my
mouth, I was just
picking fights...

entries.jp: 一言だけ　お前の音楽は\n最高だって
entries.en: Just one thing...\nthat your music\nis the best.

entries.jp: お前にならあのギターを\n託せるっていつか言おうと\n思ってたのに……
entries.en:
That I could trust
you with that
guitar. I always
meant to tell you
someday...

entries.jp: 俺も技術のことばかり\nとやかく言って\nしまった……
entries.en: And I only ever\nnagged you\nabout technique...

entries.jp: そんなものじゃなく\nお前の歌にある熱情を\nただ尊敬していたのに
entries.en:
...when it wasn't
that at all. I
simply respected
the passion in
your singing.

entries.jp: 死ぬな　坂本！\n俺はお前ともっともっと\n歌いたいんだ！
entries.en:
Don't die,
Sakamoto! I want
to sing with you
so much more!

entries.jp: オレもだ！\nオレももっとお前とずっと\nロックをやりたい……！
entries.en:
Me too! I wanna
keep playing
rock with you,
way more...!

entries.jp:
龍馬にすがるように
高杉と土方が嘆く
なぜか　その姿を
桂と沖田は遠巻きに
していた
entries.en:
Takasugi and
Hijikata grieved,
clinging to
Ryoma. For some
reason, though,
Katsura and
Okita kept their
distance.

entries.jp: ……くぅっ！\n桂さんも何か龍馬に\n言ってやってくれよ
entries.en:
...Ngh!
Katsura-san,
say something
to Ryoma too!

entries.jp: 総司も坂本に\n別れを……
entries.en: Soji, you too...\nsay goodbye\nto Sakamoto...

entries.jp: そう言われても……
entries.en: Even if you\nsay that...

entries.jp: だって　ねえ？\nトサカくん　\n狸寝入りだし？
entries.en:
I mean, come on.
Tosaka-kun's
just playing
possum, isn't he?

entries.jp: 息してますよね\n血も流れ出して\nませんし……
entries.en:
He's breathing,
isn't he? And
he isn't
bleeding at all...

entries.jp: \fnt1……は？\fnt0
entries.en: \fnt1...Huh?\fnt0

entries.jp: あ～っ！\nなんでバラすんじゃ\nソウちん　センセー！
entries.en: Aaagh! Why'd ya\nspill it, So-chin,\nSensei!?

entries.jp: せっかく珍しく\nシンディとヒジゾーさんの\n本音が聞けたのに……
entries.en:
For once I was
finally hearin'
what Shindy
and Hijizo-san
really feel...

entries.jp: \fnt1ええっ\nな　なんで\fnt0
entries.en: \fnt1Whaaat!?\nB-but how...\fnt0

entries.jp: ……生きているのか\n心臓を撃たれて……？
entries.en: ...You're alive?\nAfter being shot\nin the heart...?

entries.jp: てへっ☆
entries.en: Tee hee!

entries.jp: \fnt1てへっじゃねえっ！\n龍馬！　テメェ！\fnt0
entries.en: \fnt1Don't you "tee\nhee" me! Ryoma,\nyou jerk!\fnt0

entries.jp: ……騙したのか\n坂本……
entries.en: ...You tricked\nus, Sakamoto...

entries.jp: い　いや　騙したわけじゃ\nないんじゃよ？
entries.en: N-now hold on,\nI wasn't trickin'\nanybody, y'hear?

entries.jp: 胸にどーんってきて痛くて\n息が出来なくなってたのは\n本当のことぜよ
entries.en:
Somethin'
slammed into
my chest, and it
hurt so bad I
couldn't breathe.
That part's true!

entries.jp: というか　よく銃で胸を\n撃たれて生きてるね\nトサカくん　人間？
entries.en:
More like, how
are you alive
after getting
shot in the chest?
Tosaka-kun, are
you even human?

entries.jp: わしは人間じゃ！\nこれが胸に入ってたから\n助かったんじゃ
entries.en:
Course I'm
human! I was
saved 'cause I
had this tucked
in my chest!

entries.jp: おやおや\nそれはギターの\n爪（ピック）ですか
entries.en: Well, well. Is that\na guitar pick?

entries.jp: それで弾が止まるなんて\nトサカくんは悪運強いなぁ
entries.en:
A pick stopped
a bullet?
Tosaka-kun,
you've got the
devil's own luck.

entries.jp: 爪程度で防げるかよ\nありえねえ……
entries.en: A pick can't stop\na bullet. No way...

entries.jp: すぐ壊れるから\n頑丈なの\n作ったんじゃ
entries.en:
They kept
breakin' on me,
so we made a
tough one!

entries.jp: はい\n私が作りました\nじつは鉄で出来てます
entries.en: Yes, I made\nit. It's actually\nmade of iron.

entries.jp: さすがに　歪んでいますね\n作り直さないと……
entries.en: Even so, it's quite\nbent. I'll have to\nmake a new one...

entries.jp: しばらく　気を失って\nたんだと思うぜよ
entries.en: I reckon I blacked\nout for a bit.

entries.jp: 目が覚めたらシンディと\nヒジゾーさんがえっらい\n泣いてるから……
entries.en:
When I came
to, Shindy and
Hijizo-san were
bawlin' their
eyes out, so...

entries.jp: 起きるに起きれんで……
entries.en: ...I couldn't\nexactly get up.

entries.jp: 誰も泣いてねえ！
entries.en: Nobody\nwas crying!

entries.jp: まったく\n人騒がせなヤツだ
entries.en: Honestly. You\ngave us all a\nscare for nothing.

entries.jp: でもスカシくんも\n土方さんも目が赤いよ？
entries.en:
But Mr. Poser
and Hijikata-san,
your eyes are all
red, you know?

entries.jp: こ　これは\n目にゴミが入っただけだ！
entries.en: Th-this is just\ndust in my eyes!

entries.jp: そうだ\n汗がしみただけだ
entries.en: That's right. Just\nsweat stinging\nmy eyes.

entries.jp: 俺はお前ともっともっと\n歌いたいんだ
entries.en: "I want to sing\nwith you so\nmuch more!"

entries.jp: うっ
entries.en: Urk.

entries.jp: オレももっとお前とずっと\nロックをやりたい
entries.en: "I wanna keep\nplaying rock with\nyou, way more!"

entries.jp: ううっ
entries.en: Ugh...

entries.jp: 二人が忘れても私は\nちゃんと覚えてますよ？
entries.en:
Even if you
two forget,
I'll remember
it perfectly,
you know?

entries.jp: あの言葉には二人の\nロックが詰まってた\n感激しました
entries.en:
Those words
were packed
with both of your
rock souls. I was
deeply moved.

entries.jp: さっすがメガネくん！\n良いこと言うね～
entries.en: Way to go,\nGlasses-kun!\nWell said~

entries.jp: うんうん　あの言葉は\nわしの胸にず～んと\n響いたぜよ
entries.en:
Yep, yep. Those
words hit me
right here in the
chest, they did.

entries.jp: ほらほら観念して\n素直になっちゃいなよ
entries.en: Come on, come\non, give it up\nand be honest~

entries.jp: わしももう一回\n聞きたいぜよー
entries.en: I wanna hear\n'em one more\ntime too!

entries.jp: だってさ　晋作\n土方さん
entries.en: You heard\nthem, Shinsaku,\nHijikata-san.

entries.jp: うるさい！　\n二度も言うか！
entries.en: Shut up! Like\nI'd say it twice!

entries.jp: あんな恥ずかしいことは\n二度と言ってやらん！
entries.en:
I'll never say
something that
embarrassing
again!

entries.jp: それより　襲った者を\n突き止めねばな……
entries.en:
More
importantly, we
need to find out
who attacked us...

entries.jp:
そうそう　二度も
奇跡（ラッキー）は
ないだろうし
幕府の残党か……
entries.en:
Right. We can't
count on getting
lucky twice.
Shogunate
holdouts,
perhaps...

entries.jp: 解体されたことに\n怨みを持つ者も\n多いだろうからな
entries.en:
Plenty of them
must hold a
grudge over its
dismantling.

entries.jp: 真面目な顔して\n誤魔化しちゃって～
entries.en:
Putting on a
serious face
to change
the subject~

entries.jp: 真面目な話だっ！
entries.en: This IS serious!

entries.jp: 惜しかったぜよ～\nセンセーとソウちんのも\n聞きたかったぜよ～
entries.en:
Aw, so close! I
wanted to hear
Sensei's and
So-chin's too!

entries.jp: えっ　トサカくん\n僕に愛を語られたいの？\nいいよ～　語っちゃうよ
entries.en:
Huh? Tosaka-kun,
you want me to
confess my love
to you? Sure~ I'll
pour my heart
out.

entries.jp: 私の愛は龍馬くんに\n届いてないんでしょうかね
entries.en: Has my love not\nreached you,\nRyoma-kun?

entries.jp: わー　そんなことは\nないぜよ　センセー！
entries.en: Whoa, that\nain't so, Sensei!

entries.jp: 大好きじゃ！　センセーも\nソウちんもシンディも\nヒジゾーさんもっ！
entries.en:
I love ya!
Sensei, So-chin,
Shindy, and
Hijizo-san too!

entries.jp: わいわいがやがやと\n騒がしく龍馬たちは\n京の街を歩いていく
entries.en:
Laughing and
chattering,
Ryoma and the
others went
noisily on
through the
streets of Kyoto.

entries.jp: 暗殺騒ぎもなんのその
entries.en: An assassination\nattempt was no\nmatter at all.

entries.jp: 龍馬たちのロック街道は\nまだまだ続いていく……！
entries.en:
Ryoma and
company's road
of rock goes on
and on...!
